frames.narration: The answers are not good enough. There are three levers, and each changes something different.
Lever 1, prompting: better instructions and a few examples go with every request. Fast and free to roll back.
Lever 2, retrieval: the policy passages that matter are fetched at question time. Update a document and the answers follow.
Lever 3, fine-tuning: further training changes the weights, so style, format or a skill is built in. It is a snapshot, so it does not follow changing facts.
Match the lever to the problem: missing or changing knowledge points to retrieval, tone and format to prompting first, consistency at volume to fine-tuning.
Start with the cheapest, measure against a test set, and combine the levers only when a gap remains.
